subtitle: Pine Needles at New Year

object_reference.name: Pine Needles
object_reference.note: The narrator remembers pine needles spread on the floor for childhood Lunar New Year meals. A small pine sprig is a representative symbol of that tradition; no specific family heirloom or pine species is documented.
